Story Canon Ledger

Fulcrum pilot • Working continuity, metaphysics, cast, romance, and practice rules • v0.1

The ledger separates locked story law from working invention and open choices. It is meant to be updated after every accepted scene.

1. Status vocabulary

LOCKED

Established by the approved v0.3 brief; scenes may elaborate but not contradict.

WORKING

Current best choice for drafting; change through an explicit canon decision.

OPEN

Deliberately undecided; candidate scenes may test alternatives.

REVEAL

True in the storyworld but withheld from readers or characters until a named beat.

2. Core story law

Status

Domain

Canon statement

LOCKED

Format

Adult new-adult romantic supernatural-tech thriller; 80,000–100,000 words if the pilot succeeds.

LOCKED

Setting

Fulcrum is a postsecondary residential fellowship for early-twenties technology heirs, protégés, and unusually promising outsiders.

LOCKED

Institutional engine

Members try to solve alignment in machines and then in themselves; secrecy, urgency, charismatic asymmetry, and epistemic overreach turn good intentions dangerous.

LOCKED

Christian claim

Chastity integrates desire into attention, agency, love, prayer, delight, confession, and sound judgment.

LOCKED

Romantic engine

Heat rises through attention, anticipation, mutual perception, humor, and freely chosen limits.

LOCKED

Ending move

Mara wins by creating conditions for truth: witnesses, records, consent, exit rights, confession, mercy, and one public act no faction fully explains.

WORKING

Heat ceiling

Maximum on-page erotic charge without graphic sex acts or genital description; the pilot’s central couple does not consummate.

WORKING

Time and place

Near-future Northern California, across one ten-week Fulcrum term.

3. Dramatic epistemology

Every uncanny beat has three layers: observation, character interpretation, and underlying mechanism.

At least two materially different explanations remain live through the midpoint.

Body-reading is real as high-resolution social perception; its scope and supernatural remainder remain contested.

Prayer can produce courage, clarity, timing, and unexpected events. The narration shows effects before assigning metaphysics.

Testimony remains character-bound: sincere does not mean complete; mistaken does not mean worthless.

No faction owns the vocabulary of reality. Vocabulary changes what characters notice and which actions become available.

The final public act permits a Christian reading that is causally potent without forcing every witness into the same account.

4. Working cast

Status

Character

Function

Charge

Arc

False belief

WORKING

Mara Vale, 22

Protagonist

Sheltered, formidable, observant; evangelical formation with sacramental hunger.

Borrowed virtue becomes embodied conviction.

Mistakes perfect self-control for holiness and thinks visible uncertainty forfeits authority.

WORKING

Jonah Reed, 24

Romantic counterpart

Hardware security researcher; playful, patient, socially fluent without being socially owned.

Learns that protecting Mara’s freedom requires public cost, not private niceness.

Believes he can stay clean by remaining unofficial and ironic.

WORKING

Livia Sloane, 23

Friend-rival

Sensuous, brilliant, wounded; Fulcrum’s most gifted attention reader.

Moves from social command toward costly truth, with redemption left genuinely available.

Equates being able to move people with being able to love them.

WORKING

Dr. Miriam Holt, 46

Mentor

Clinician and prayer minister adjacent to Fulcrum, unimpressed by its glamour.

Models authority through humility, precision, and protected refusal.

Carries an old failure that makes her slow to intervene publicly.

WORKING

Adrian Voss, 38

Institutional face

Founder-theorist who makes every crisis legible inside Fulcrum’s system.

Must choose between preserving the world-saving narrative and telling the truth.

Believes a sufficiently complete model makes coercion unnecessary—and therefore cannot see his own coercion.

5. Fulcrum system

System element

Working canon

Public mission

Build technical and psychological alignment tools capable of surviving civilizational pressure.

Recruitment promise

You are unusually good, unusually needed, and finally among people who can see the whole of you.

Core practices

Calibration games; belief reports; charting; paired attention work; all-night salons; alignment vigils; confession-like debriefs.

Status currency

Access to the founder, accuracy in reading others, emotional transparency, tolerance for intensity, and visible sacrifice for the mission.

Soft enforcement

Departure is reframed as fear, resistance, hidden misalignment, or abandonment of humanity.

Material vulnerability

Housing, work, romance, reputation, and friendship overlap inside one dense network.

Counter-power

Records, witnesses, outside friendships, prayer, sleep, ordinary work, denominational plurality, and the protected right to leave.

6. Romance invariants

Neither lead uses arousal as a debt, a test of loyalty, or proof of spiritual maturity.

A stated limit increases sensory and interpersonal specificity in the prose.

Jonah’s attractiveness depends on his capacity to wait, attend, apologize, protect boundaries, and stay playful.

Mara’s chastity is active competence: she can perceive desire, enjoy it, speak clearly, and choose timing.

The central romantic ordeal forces both characters to prefer the other’s freedom over possession, certainty, status, or climax.

Their first true intimacy is a successful repair after one of them causes real harm.

7. Portable practices that may enter scenes

Practice

Dramatic action

The three-second beat

Notice sensation, breath once, name the offered frame, then choose.

One clean question

Stop defending; ask the question the other person’s frame is designed to prevent.

Witness before interpretation

Record what was said, who was present, and what changed before naming the mechanism.

Prayerful reorientation

Return attention to God, receive identity, and ask what loving action is possible now.

Fast confession

Name the act and harm without turning the explanation into self-exoneration.

Mercy with structure

Forgive while setting access, witness, timing, and restitution conditions appropriate to reality.

8. Open decisions

Whether Fulcrum remains the final name.

Mara’s exact denomination, family structure, and reason for accepting the fellowship.

The specific external alignment project whose deadline powers the plot.

What Miriam failed to prevent in her earlier ministry or research life.

How far Livia’s final act travels toward repentance, restitution, or renewed rivalry.

Which explanation best accounts for the public act at the climax—and what residue remains unexplained.
title: Story Canon Ledger — Fulcrum Pilot v0.1
